name: 02152 · Winthrop, MA
findings: ZIP 02152 (Winthrop) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02152 (Winthrop) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02152 (Winthrop) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
